products.title: MSI RTX5080 VENTUS 3X OC PLUS 16G D7 GAMING
products.body_html:
MSI RTX5080 VENTUS 3X OC PLUS 16G D7 GAMING

The MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16G Ventus 3X OC Plus is a high-end graphics card based on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, known for strong gaming and content creation performance.

  • GPU architecture: Built on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, featuring 4th-Gen Ray Tracing Cores and 5th-Gen Tensor Cores for enhanced performance.
  • Memory: 16GB of GDDR7 memory on a 256-bit bus, offering a 34% increase in bandwidth over the previous generation RTX 4080.
  • Overclocking: The OC Plus model is factory-overclocked for higher performance out of the box. You can further fine-tune performance using MSI Afterburner software.
  • AI acceleration: Supports DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, which can boost frame rates by using AI to generate additional frames. It also includes other AI-powered features like NVIDIA Broadcast and NVIDIA Studio.
  • Cooling: The card is equipped with a triple-fan cooling system that uses MSI's TORX FAN 5.0 technology for high-pressure airflow and effective heat dissipation. A solid metal backplate also reinforces the card and provides additional cooling.
  • Display outputs: Features three DisplayPort 2.1b ports and one HDMI 2.1b port, supporting multi-monitor setups and high-resolution, high-refresh-rate displays.
  • Form factor: The design is relatively compact for a high-end card, with a standard three-fan setup that is designed to fit most cases.
